brief: Two-storey frame upright-and-wing house with a one-storey side wing; the gable front got a full-width porch on square brick piers with a solid rail in the 1920s. Clapboard with 2/2 windows, on a corner of a quiet residential street. Record gap: 2 photos only.

facade.notes: an 1880s-1910s house remodelled as a foursquare: two storeys under a hip roof, cement-asbestos shingle siding, a full front porch on squat rock-faced concrete-block piers with a square-baluster rail and lattice skirting; a semi-trailer tractor parked in the side yard; deep snow

why.note: rock-faced concrete block (1900-30 machine-made) for porch piers and foundations
